case_title: COHEN, TOMER VS THE CITY TOW

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,500.00 FILED BY COHEN, TOMER AS TO DEFENDANT THE CITY TOW ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAR-14-2000 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
